GS.rationale: Goldman Sachs presents a solid fundamental picture with improving profitability and strong competitive positioning, but valuation has expanded significantly over the past year, limiting upside. The Q1 2026 results were strong ($17.23B revenue, $17.55 EPS, 19.8% ROE), and the firm is the #1 global M&A advisor with 32% market share. However, the P/E has expanded from ~13x in mid-2025 to ~17.5x currently, near the top of its 12-18.4x range, and P/B has moved from 1.5x to 2.3x. The M&A recovery and Basel III capital relief provide near-term tailwinds, but the stock's strong run (+37.5% in 12 months) means much of the good news is priced in. Macro backdrop is mixed: rising oil prices and geopolitical tensions create trading opportunities but also risk, while the yield curve has modestly steepened. The score reflects a quality franchise with positive trajectory but tempered by stretched valuation relative to its own history.
